content.thinking: The bug is clear. The comment specifies that fields containing commas, double quotes, or line breaks must be wrapped in quotes, with embedded quotes doubled.

The fix is to include `"` in the NEEDS_QUOTING regex.

The regex already handles `\r`, so only the quote character needs to be added. The test support mock already includes quotes, but the production escape logic does not. I will apply the one-line fix and stop.

content.text: The CSV writer quotes commas and line breaks, but a title that only contains a double quote is left unquoted, so the spreadsheet splits the field. I'll include `"` in the characters that force quoting.

content.thinking: The fix is complete. No summary is needed.
